description: This Java source file defines the CachedNamespaceInvalidator class, an Akka actor responsible for invalidating cache entries related to blocked namespaces in a distributed system.

classes.name: CachedNamespaceInvalidator
classes.description: An Akka actor that invalidates cache entries for blocked namespaces, listening to namespace changes and scheduling invalidation.

classes.name: InvalidateCachedNamespaces
classes.description: A helper class representing a set of namespaces to invalidate.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props for the CachedNamespaceInvalidator actor with specified blocked namespaces and caches.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling behavior for the actor.

methods.name: logUnhandled
methods.description: Logs messages that are not handled by the actor.

methods.name: handleChanged
methods.description: Handles changes from the Replicator, triggering namespace invalidation if applicable.

methods.name: logNamespaces
methods.description: Logs the namespaces received or invalidated.

methods.name: invalidateNamespacesAfterDelay
methods.description: Schedules a delayed invalidation of namespaces.

methods.name: invalidateCachedNamespaces
methods.description: Performs invalidation of cache entries for specified namespaces.

methods.name: invalidateNamespaces
methods.description: Invalidates cache entries for a specific cache and set of namespaces.

methods.name: containsNamespaceOfEntityId
methods.description: Checks if an entity ID's namespace is within the set of blocked namespaces.
